notes.subject: סלסלה
notes.rationale: Piel reduplication of סלל, 'heap up/exalt' — the doubled consonants intensify the lifting, lost in Icelandic

notes.subject: כי
notes.rationale: rendered 'þegar' (when); Hebrew כי here is causal-temporal 'for/because', not conditional 'if' as KJV margin

notes.subject: hún
notes.rationale: feminine subject pronoun (speki) supplied where Hebrew verb forms imply it

translation: Háfa hana, og ⟨hún⟩ mun upphæja þig; ⟨hún⟩ mun vegsama þig, þegar þú faðmar hana.
